text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to achieve. It is also important to define milestones—key points in the project timeline that show progress—and deliverables, the final products or results you must complete. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. Everyone involved, from team members to clients, should agree on the goals and expectations from the start. This reduces misunderstandings and keeps the project moving in the right direction.
